comments.text: EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google DeepMind's open, lightweight multimodal embedding model. It maps text, code, images, video and audio into one shared space and is small enough to run on a phone.Problem: Searching by meaning usually needs a pipeline of separate models: a captioning model for images, speech-to-text for audio, a text embedder on top. That's slow, memory-hungry, and often sends your data to the cloud. For private, on-device apps, that's a hard trade-off.Solution: One 740M-parameter model, built on the Gemma 4 architecture, that embeds all five types of content in the same space. A text query can find a photo, and a voice memo can find a video clip. Everything runs locally, so your data never has to leave the device.What makes it different: It's modular. You can load only the encoders you need, as little as 270M parameters for text and code, plus optional vision (170M) and audio (300M) encoders. With quantization on a Pixel 11 Pro, it needs about 191MB of RAM for text only and about 567MB for the full multimodal model. week.name: Onepin

week.description: AI voices sound human now. But they still guess names from the spelling, and nobody has time to listen to every line. comments.text: Hey Product Hunt 👋 SB here, founder of Onepin. Thanks @rohanrecommends for hunting us.A great AI voice reads "Porsche Taycan" as TAY-can. Porsche says TIE-kahn. Onepin checks how a name was said, not just what the transcript spells. And there is no box where you type phonetic spellings: the dictionary and the fix do that work, so your script stays as written.Built for anyone shipping AI voiceover at volume: product videos, ads, explainers, dubbing, audiobooks, courses, and platforms that put a voice in front of millions of users. The code is under the 20% off badge above.One question for you: what's the word your AI voice keeps getting wrong? week.aiReview: مسئله اصلی که Zernio حل می‌کند، پراکندگی و پیچیدگی یکپارچه‌سازی با کانال‌های مختلف بازاریابی است؛ توسعه‌دهندگان مجبورند برای هر پلتفرم (از اینستاگرام تا واتس‌اپ) کد جداگانه بنویسند و آن را به‌روزرسانی کنند. راه‌حل Zernio ارائه یک لایه میانی (Middleware) است که تمام این پیچیدگی‌ها را پنهان می‌کند و یک API استاندارد ارائه می‌دهد. از نظر معماری، این محصول بر پایه REST API و همچنین MCP (Model Context Protocol) برای اتصال به هوش مصنوعی‌ها طراحی شده است که نشان‌دهنده رویکرد آینده‌نگرانه آن است. مدل درآمدی احتمالاً بر اساس حجم تراکنش‌ها (پیام‌ها، تماس‌ها) و تعداد کاربران فعال است. نقاط قوت اصلی شامل پوشش گسترده کانال‌ها، تمرکز بر توسعه‌دهندگان و پشتیبانی از هوش مصنوعی است. نقاط ضعف می‌تواند شامل وابستگی به APIهای پلتفرم‌های خارجی و احتمال تغییرات ناگهانی در آن‌ها باشد. نکته طلایی برای ایران: با توجه به نبود APIهای رسمی برای پلتفرم‌های داخلی مانند ایتا و روبیکا، ایجاد یک لایه یکپارچه‌سازی که از طریق پروتکل‌های استاندارد (مانند MCP) به هوش مصنوعی‌ها متصل شود، می‌تواند یک مزیت رقابتی بزرگ برای کسب‌وکارهای ایرانی باشد که می‌خواهند بازاریابی خود را خودکار کنند.

month.name: Voiskey
month.tagline: AI voice typing that sounds right in every app
month.description: Voiskey starts from what you meant, not just what you said. Speak a rough thought and it comes back shaped for where it's going and who's reading it: casual with a friend, composed with a colleague, technical with an AI. It arrives 5x faster than typing, cleaned up and ready to send, while you still sound like you. Voiskey is now available on iOS, macOS, Android, and Windows, in over 100 languages. It's free to start. Join during launch and get a free month of Pro.

comments.text: Hi Product Hunt, I'm Jenny, from the Voiskey team. We started this because of the same wall we kept hitting - AI dictation still isn't truly edit-free. The text comes out polished, and a lot of the time sanded flat: a message to a friend comes back like a memo, or a note to a colleague comes back like a template. None of it sounds like you, so you have to go back in and manually re-edit it before you send it. That's what Voiskey is built around. We called it "expression intelligence". Voiskey doesn't just catching your words. It works out what you meant, who's going to read it, and how you'd have put it yourself. The polish moves. Your voice stays. Why Voiskey: * Fits the moment. Reads the situation you're writing into and adjusts how the text comes out. * Keeps your voice. Your slang, your shorthand, and your way of putting things stay. * Learns your words. Remembers the names and terms you correct, so you fix them once. * Translates as you speak. Say it in your language, send it in theirs. It reads native, not translated. * Ask AI. Say what you want written and it lands in the field. Ask a question and the answer opens in a window. It's free to try, and there's a free month of Pro during launch. We'd love to hear what you think!

Identify your triggers, reverse the damage in minutes, and watch the stress curve drop in real time as you act. No 30-minute meditations. No diet overhaul. No long hours at the gym. Just well-timed actions based on YOUR body's data.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt! I'm Jane, co-founder of Welltory. Today we're launching Real-Time Stress Relief – a feature that's been years in the making.Why we built this:Most wearables tell you stress was high yesterday. Great. Now what?We spent years analyzing data from 16M+ users to understand something nobody else was looking at: the invisible moments when your heart races while you're sitting still. These "sedentary stress" episodes don't just drain your energy - they're accumulating cardiovascular risk over time.What makes this different:This isn't generic wellness advice. Every insight is based on YOUR personal data and powered by AI trained on millions of people. The app shows you exactly when stress is building right now, what's triggering it, and gives you timed actions to reverse it before you're toast at 8pm.Often it's just: Move for 5 minutes. Simple. Measurable. Effective.Our mission:Preventive health through real-time stress management. This launch is just the beginning - we're working on helping people catch cardiovascular risks before they become problems.My personal lifehack? Just laying down with laptop on a couch during Zoom meetings where I'm not the leading speaker. Sounds lazy, but it works and allows me to be alive for the next and more demanding one.We're done waiting for burnout to tell us we've pushed too far. The data to prevent it is already tracking you – we're just making it impossible to ignore.🎁 Special for the Product Hunt Community:As a thank you, use the promo code welltory_ph_25 to get up to 52% off your annual or lifetime subscription. We'd love for you to experience the full power of one app for your health.Try it and let me know what patterns you discover about yourself. I'd especially love your feedback if you're someone who feels drained by 8pm and can't figure out why.Excited to hear what works for you!Jane

year.name: Gemini 3
year.tagline: Bring any idea to life with multimodal capabilities
year.description: Our most intelligent model that helps you bring any idea to life.

comments.text: Hey Hunters, I am excited to hunt 🚀Google just dropped Gemini 3, and it’s looking seriously powerful — especially for multimodal understanding and agentic tasks. The new “vibe coding” capabilities + faster context grasping make it feel much more intuitive with fewer prompts.You can already try Gemini 3 Pro in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search. Developers can jump in via Google AI Studio and Vertex AI.If you’re building or experimenting with AI workflows, this upgrade is definitely worth checking out. Let me know what you think!

year.name: Upstream
year.tagline: The inbox designed for humans and agents
year.description: Finally, an inbox you'll look forward to. Agents sort your messages, draft your replies, and clear the grunt work behind the scenes, all in a client so well-crafted that email feels light, fast, fun.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt! 👋 Louis here, co-founder of Upstream.When I was at Algolia, I was drowning in 200 emails a day. I was never sure where to focus, and getting through my inbox took forever. I knew it didn’t have to be this way. Instead of creating a new messaging protocol, I bet on rethinking the tool everyone uses: email.We built the first email client where agents do real work alongside people. We designed Upstream to be easy to pick up and fun to use. 📥 Take the noise out of emailAgents automatically triage your inbox, separate signal from noise, and surface only what deserves your attention✍️ Every reply starts with a draftUpstream drafts replies for every conversation that needs one. It also changes your voice based on who you’re talking to and the context of the convo⏰ Never miss a follow-upAgents track open loops and remind you when needed, making sure important conversations don't fall through the cracks🔎 Ask anything about your workAI can instantly find information across your inbox and connected tools: receipts, meeting notes, introductions, decisions, conversations, and more🔗 Bring all your context into your inboxAgents use information from tools like Notion, Calendar, Drive, Granola, and other sources to produce better answers and drafts👉 As a special thank you to the Product Hunt community, you get one free month of Upstream Pro if you sign up at upstream.do and use the code PH26! 👈We are all so excited to hear what you think! Please do reply here and let me know Huge thanks to our hunter @garrytan for hunting us 🙏
congrats team for the success!

year.name: Cursor 2.0
year.tagline: Our first coding model and new interface for agents
year.description: Two big updates that make Cursor the best place to work with agents: our first coding model, Composer, and a new interface for working with many agents in parallel. Also included in this release: browser for Agent, voice mode, improved code review, and more!
